name: Parkinson'S Disease
overview: Parkinson'S Disease is a health condition that requires individualized medical assessment. Symptoms, causes, and treatment vary by person — consult a qualified doctor in India for diagnosis and a care plan tailored to your history and local guidelines.
symptoms: From a clinical perspective, parkinson's disease (PD), or simply Parkinson's, is a neurodegenerative disease primarily of the central nervous system...
In routine practice, the motor symptoms, collectively called parkinsonism, include tremors, slowness in initiating movement (bradykinesia), rigidity...
In routine practice, symptoms typically develop gradually, and non-motor issues become more prevalent as the disease progresses.
